say:2:1810644001:1.text: No ambushes behind either door, and the clues we needed were left right out in the open...
say:2:1810644001:1.source_cn: 两扇魔法门后都没有埋伏，而我们需要的线索和证据都摆在最...

say:3:1810644002:1.text: Ever since stepping into this manor, I've had this subtle feeling. It's as if someone is trying to drop us hints, but they can't say it outright.
say:3:1810644002:1.source_cn: 踏入庄园后，我就有种微妙的感觉：有人想要暗示我们什么，...

choice_prompt:4:1810644002.text: Ever since stepping into this manor, I've had this subtle feeling. It's as if someone is trying to drop us hints, but they can't say it outright.
choice_prompt:4:1810644002.source_cn: 从踏入庄园开始，就古怪得让人背后发凉……

say:5:1810644003:0.text: A ruler who's both a high-ranking member of the Syndicate and capable of maintaining autonomy under Bantus' rule wouldn't be so simple.
say:5:1810644003:0.source_cn: 一个既是黑金商会重要高层，又能在班题斯的强权下保持自治...

say:6:1810644005:1.text: Nothing she does follows logic. I can't make sense of her motives.
say:6:1810644005:1.source_cn: 苔佩希……她行事毫无章法可言，我猜不透她的动机。

say:7:1810644006:1.text: I don't care what her intentions are, as long as she doesn't harm the people of the empire. At least we know one thing now: <style="highlight">the candle blossoms given as souvenirs are harmless</style>.
say:7:1810644006:1.source_cn: 我不在乎她的意图——只要她不危害耀光人。至少现在我们可...

say:8:1810644007:1.text: And Baden and Baba Muriel are in the Refinery... We have to rescue them.
say:8:1810644007:1.source_cn: 而巴登和穆婆婆就在炼化间……该去救他们了。

say:9:1810644008:1.text: You can't go. If something should happen to you as well, the Rayne family—
say:9:1810644008:1.source_cn: 你不能去。若你也遭遇不测，瑞恩家族——

say:10:1810644009:0.text: I know what you're going to say. But even if Baden and I both die in Novaris, House Rayne will never fall.
say:10:1810644009:0.source_cn: 我知道你想说什么。但是，就算我和巴登最后都死在了诺珐斯...

say:11:1810644010:1.text: The name "Rayne" carries responsibility, not just glory. No matter who the lord or the heir is, protecting Ashvale County is our ultimate duty.
say:11:1810644010:1.source_cn: “瑞恩”之名所承载的不是荣耀，而是责任。无论家主、继承...

say:12:1810644011:1.text: I respect the conviction of the Rayne family more than anyone. But the perils of the Refinery far exceed your imagination. I can't let you risk yourself like this. Baden would never forgive me.
say:12:1810644011:1.source_cn: 我比任何人都尊重瑞恩家族的信念。但炼化间的凶险程度远超...

say:13:1810644012:1.text: No! He might be furious that you let his cousin walk into danger, but he would never condemn a Rayne ruler for doing what duty demands.
say:13:1810644012:1.source_cn: 不！或许他会因为你让他的堂妹身处险境而气愤，但他绝不会...

say:14:1810644013:1.text: If I can't bring him home to Ashvale, then I've failed as its lord!
say:14:1810644013:1.source_cn: 若不能把他带回灰影郡，我这个家主就是失职！

say:16:1810644015:1.text: Yelling at me won't work! Come with me to the Refinery to save Baden! Or are you going to defy your lord's command?
say:16:1810644015:1.source_cn: 吼我也没用！跟我去炼化间救巴登！你要违抗家主的命令吗？

say:19:1810644017:1.text: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—
say:19:1810644017:1.male: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—
say:19:1810644017:1.female: It's not that I don't trust her, it's—

say:20:1810644018:1.text: Even if we run into danger, we can face it together!
say:20:1810644018:1.source_cn: 就算遇到危险，我们也可以合力应对！

say:22:1810644021:0.text: You're just as stubborn as Baden, Estrilda.
say:22:1810644021:0.source_cn: ……你真是和巴登一样顽固，爱丝。

say:23:1810644022:1.text: I'm much better than him. At least I give you fair warning before I act.
say:23:1810644022:1.source_cn: 我比他好太多了，至少我会在行动之前通知你。

say:27:1810644026:0.text: You instinctively follow them a few steps, then suddenly remember Tephesia's access crystal. It seems to be linked to a place closely connected to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:27:1810644026:0.source_cn: 你下意识地跟着他们走出两步，却突然想起了身上的那枚属于...
say:27:1810644026:0.male: You instinctively follow them a few steps, then suddenly remember Tephesia's access crystal. It seems to be linked to a place closely connected to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:27:1810644026:0.female: You instinctively follow them a few steps, then suddenly remember Tephesia's access crystal. It seems to be linked to a place closely connected to the Adamant Syndicate.

say:28:1810644027:0.text: Rescuing those two is urgent, but if you miss this chance, who knows when you'll uncover Syndicate secrets again?
say:28:1810644027:0.source_cn: 虽然救人一事也十分紧要，但如果错过这次机会，不知道要等...
say:28:1810644027:0.male: Rescuing those two is urgent, but if you miss this chance, who knows when you'll uncover Syndicate secrets again?
say:28:1810644027:0.female: Rescuing those two is urgent, but if you miss this chance, who knows when you'll uncover Syndicate secrets again?

say:31:1810644029:0.text: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...
say:31:1810644029:0.source_cn: 什么事？你一个人没问题吗？虽然我也不希望你跟着我们去炼...
say:31:1810644029:0.male: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...
say:31:1810644029:0.female: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...

choice_prompt:32:1810644029.text: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...
choice_prompt:32:1810644029.source_cn: 什么事？你一个人没问题吗？虽然我也不希望你跟着我们去炼化间涉险……
choice_prompt:32:1810644029.male: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...
choice_prompt:32:1810644029.female: What is it? Will you be alright on your own? Though I don't want you risking your neck with us in the Refinery either...

say:33:1810644030:0.text: Go then, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't push forward recklessly if you run into danger. You can retreat to the Bone Hut to lie low if you need.
say:33:1810644030:0.male: Go then, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't push forward recklessly if you run into danger. You can retreat to the Bone Hut to lie low if you need.
say:33:1810644030:0.female: Go then, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't push forward recklessly if you run into danger. You can retreat to the Bone Hut to lie low if you need.

say:34:1810644031:0.text: Take care of yourself. Stay safe.
say:34:1810644031:0.male: Take care of yourself. Stay safe.
say:34:1810644031:0.female: Take care of yourself. Stay safe.

narration:40:18010634:0.source_cn: 目送爱丝特瑞达与瑟恩离开后，你使用苔佩希的通行水晶来到...
narration:40:18010634:0.male: After seeing Estrilda and Thane off, you use Tephesia's access crystal to reach the Adamant Syndicate HQ.
narration:40:18010634:0.female: After seeing Estrilda and Thane off, you use Tephesia's access crystal to reach the Adamant Syndicate HQ.

choice:32:0:1.text: Don't worry, I'll catch up later.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 没事，我还能回去帮你们
choice:32:0:1.male: Don't worry, I'll catch up later.
choice:32:0:1.female: Don't worry, I'll catch up later.

choice:32:1:2.text: You underestimate me! I'll come save the day once I'm done!
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 太小瞧我了！我查完还能去救场！
choice:32:1:2.male: You underestimate me! I'll come save the day once I'm done!
choice:32:1:2.female: You underestimate me! I'll come save the day once I'm done!

choice:30:0:1.text: Sorry, I need to investigate something else.
choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我得去黑金商会调查其他事
choice:30:0:1.male: Sorry, I need to investigate something else.
choice:30:0:1.female: Sorry, I need to investigate something else.

choice:18:1:2.text: A steward should listen to their lady.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 我得说，管家就该听家主的
choice:18:1:2.male: A steward should listen to their lady.
choice:18:1:2.female: A steward should listen to their lady.

choice:4:0:1.text: Maybe Tephesia was just too lazy to hide them.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 也许是苔佩希太懒了，懒得藏
choice:4:0:1.male: Maybe Tephesia was just too lazy to hide them.
choice:4:0:1.female: Maybe Tephesia was just too lazy to hide them.

say:42:1810644004:1.text: It's possible, but we have no concrete evidence.
say:42:1810644004:1.source_cn: 不排除这种可能。但我们目前没有实质性的证据。

choice:4:1:2.text: Could there be a rift between Bantus and the Syndicate?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 没准黑金和班题斯有矛盾？
